why: Device on/off|The M3 clock has no on or off. The light stays hollow.
Position|The degree to read. No reading from the owner yet. No Nara identity is chosen: the M3 form is the person's own. Choose one in the Nara instrument.
Turn|Which turn of the wheel to show. No reading from the owner yet.
Open|Draw the parts of the wheel apart. No reading from the owner yet.
lines: No owner reading in this host. The stage is the Expressions frame's native field; it is not open here.
